name: tool-path-resolution
body: The suite-tool boundary in the shared plumbing `opencode-suite/lib/apg.ts`: it resolves the caller-supplied project `directory` to the project root (`ts.apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.findApgRoot`) and runs each curated tool's Cypher from that root (`ts.apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.runCypher`), turning the graph's stored repo-relative identities into absolute filesystem paths the agent can read. It is the concrete owner of absolute-at-the-tool-boundary, distinct from solution.component.identity-layer, which stores the relative identity and explicitly disclaims resolution.
